config.temptradeoffs.title: Temporary Tradeoffs Settings
config.temptradeoffs.pool_options: Other settings are in the config file
config.temptradeoffs.positive_help: Set the weight of every positive option. Lower weight = higher selection chance.
config.temptradeoffs.negative_help: Set the weight of every negative option. Lower weight = higher selection chance.
config.temptradeoffs.general_help: The maximum weight limits the budget from which a card side is generated.
config.temptradeoffs.cte2_integration: Craft to Exile 2 / Mine and Slash integration
config.temptradeoffs.value_tooltip: Effect value: status-effect level or numeric modifier for an attribute/stat.
config.temptradeoffs.weight_tooltip: Variant weight: affects its cost in the card budget and its random selection probability.
config.temptradeoffs.enabled_tooltip: Enable this specific effect variant. The check/cross changes only this row.
config.temptradeoffs.disabled_tooltip: This variant is disabled. Click to enable only this specific variant.
config.temptradeoffs.done_tooltip: Save changes and close the settings.
config.temptradeoffs.status_submenu_tool: Settings for Minecraft status effects shown with effect icons.
config.temptradeoffs.other_submenu_toolt: Settings for attributes and other modifiers without a standard status-effect icon.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.triggers: Conditions that create new choice cards.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.selection: Number of cards and their generation budget limits.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.pool: Effect categories that are allowed in the pool.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.positive_ta: Configure positive effects, values, weights and enabled variants.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.negative_ta: Configure negative effects, values, weights and enabled variants.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.choices: How many choice cards are shown at once.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.cooldown_da: Minimum number of Minecraft days between automatic offers.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.positive_bu: Target budget for positive effects in one card. The generator tries to fill it as closely as possible.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.negative_bu: Target budget for negative effects in one card. The generator tries to fill it as closely as possible.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.min_effects: Minimum number of effects on each side of a card.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.max_effects: Maximum number of effects on each side of a card.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.new_day: Offer new cards when a new Minecraft day begins.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.level_up: Offer new cards when the player levels up.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.on_login: Offer cards on login only when the player has no selected fate yet.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.freeze: Freeze and protect the player while choosing.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.hud_button: Show the draggable cod icon for opening the current choice in inventory.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.modded_effe: Allow compatible status effects from installed mods.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.modded_attr: Allow compatible attributes from installed mods.
config.temptradeoffs.tooltip.cte2_integr: Enable extra Craft to Exile 2 / Mine and Slash stats when detected.
